description: This file defines the SessionKey enum with static methods for handling and generating session key strings, including normalization, formation, and validation functions.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string by trimming whitespace and providing a default value if empty.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string for an agent using agent ID and base key, after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given session key string is considered a canonical 'main' session key, including global and agent prefixes.
